models.name: Full primitive symmetry
models.desc: every vowel and marker receives a polar pole like consonants
models.source_support: PARTIAL — S1 says vowels have acoustic roots, but NOT that the roots are polar; forcing full polar symmetry over-assumes (guardrail caution).
models.authored_parameters_required: HIGH (2 poles × 18 units = ~36 authored, all currently MISSING)
models.falsifiability: LOW (many free parameters invite post-hoc fit)

models.name: Consonant semantics, vowel transitions
models.desc: consonants carry propensity; vowels control transition/direction/activation/linkage
models.source_support: PARTIAL — matches the patent FIELD/positional apparatus (S2, AUTHORED) but conflicts with S1 (Sarkar vowel roots).
models.table_compatible: vowels get operator roles, not table rows

models.name: Hierarchical akṣara model
models.desc: meaning arises at the consonant-vowel/akṣara unit; neither interpreted independently
models.source_support: PARTIAL — the patent permits 'syllabic or phonetic units'; the parser already emits an akṣara layer. But no source gives akṣara-level meanings.

models.name: Mixed typed inventory
models.source_support: STRONGEST STRUCTURAL FIT — S4 (vowels load-bearing, heterogeneous from consonants) + guardrail (don't clone consonant model) + S1 (vowels have their OWN roots) → typed classes. Vowel role sub-cell (polar primitive vs operator) remains UNRESOLVED between S1 and S2.
models.authored_parameters_required: LOW-MEDIUM (typed roles, vowel specifics deferred to a provenance study)
models.table_compatible: additive typed sections; no consonant change
models.falsifiability: HIGH (each typed role is a distinct testable claim)

models.name: Consonant-only semantic core
models.desc: vowels and markers preserved structurally but contribute NO semantic content
models.source_support: REFUTED as COMPLETE by S4 (privative-a and length flip meaning); tenable ONLY as an explicit, declared partial scope, not as the theory.
models.falsifiability: HIGH but already contradicted for the a-privative/length cases
models.explains_45pct_without_inventing: only by declaring 45% out of semantic scope

architecture_reason: Model D (typed-mixed) is the minimal structure jointly forced by the sources: S4 proves vowels/prefix/length are meaning-load-bearing (refuting E as a complete theory) yet heterogeneous from consonants (so not the consonant pole model, per the guardrail); S1 says vowels/aṃ/aḥ have their OWN roots (so not mere carriers). Typed classes with distinct roles fit all three while deferring the one genuinely conflicted sub-question — the vowel role cell (polar primitive per S1 vs positional operator per the deprecated English apparatus S2) — to a provenance study. Chosen for source fidelity + falsifiability + back-fit resistance, NOT coverage.
